name: Goal completed with clean tracking
expectedBehavior: Offer an optional general note without inventing a problem.

name: Session ended below the repetition goal
expectedBehavior: Ask for optional context about ending below the goal without assuming why.

name: Goal completed with tracking interruptions
expectedBehavior: Ask about tracking or camera interruptions rather than implying exercise failure.

name: Goal completed with incomplete cycles recorded
expectedBehavior: Ask about the incomplete cycles without inventing their timing or cause.
